# Data contracts

**v0, update via PR.** Both tracks (modeling and app) code against these. Mock versions of every file are generated by `python scripts/make_mocks.py` into `artifacts/mock/`.

## Artifacts

### `artifacts/scores.parquet` (written by step 4/5)

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| customer_id | str | |
| snapshot_date | date | |
| p_churn_raw | float | uncalibrated model output |
| p_churn_calibrated | float | after Platt/isotonic |
| risk_band | str | `green` / `amber` / `red`, thresholds in `config.yaml` |
| revenue_at_risk | float | `p_churn_calibrated` x customer value |
| top_drivers | list of struct | `{feature: str, label: str, contribution: float}`, top 5 by abs SHAP |

### `artifacts/segments.parquet` (step 5)

| Column | Type |
|---|---|
| customer_id | str |
| segment_id | int |
| segment_name | str |
| value_tier | str (`low` / `mid` / `high`) |

### `artifacts/allocations.parquet` (step 6)

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| customer_id | str | |
| segment_id | int | |
| value_tier | str | |
| offer | str | |
| spend | float | |
| expected_revenue_saved | float | |
| reason | str | human-readable justification |

### `artifacts/forecast.parquet` (step 5/6)

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| month | date | month start |
| actual | float | null for future months |
| forecast | float | null for past months |
| lower | float | interval lower bound |
| upper | float | interval upper bound |
| scenario | str | `no_intervention` / `with_allocation` |

## API endpoints

The API only validates input and reads artifacts; it contains no ML logic.

### `GET /health`
```json
{"status": "ok", "artifacts_loaded": true}
```

### `GET /customers`
Query: `risk_band`, `segment_id`, `limit`, `offset`.
```json
{
  "total": 200,
  "items": [
    {"customer_id": "C00001", "p_churn_calibrated": 0.62, "risk_band": "red",
     "revenue_at_risk": 412.5, "segment_name": "Fading regulars", "value_tier": "high"}
  ]
}
```

### `GET /customers/{id}`
```json
{
  "customer_id": "C00001",
  "snapshot_date": "2024-06-30",
  "p_churn_raw": 0.71,
  "p_churn_calibrated": 0.62,
  "risk_band": "red",
  "revenue_at_risk": 412.5,
  "segment": {"segment_id": 1, "segment_name": "Fading regulars", "value_tier": "high"},
  "top_drivers": [
    {"feature": "days_since_last_login", "label": "Days since last login", "contribution": 0.31}
  ],
  "allocation": {"offer": "discount_10", "spend": 50.0, "expected_revenue_saved": 120.0,
                 "reason": "High revenue at risk; Fading regulars respond to discount_10"}
}
```

### `GET /customers/{id}/report.pdf`
Returns `application/pdf`: one-page customer risk report (score, drivers, recommended offer).

### `GET /portfolio/summary`
```json
{
  "n_customers": 200,
  "total_revenue_at_risk": 18250.0,
  "band_counts": {"green": 120, "amber": 55, "red": 25},
  "by_segment": [{"segment_name": "Fading regulars", "customers": 48, "revenue_at_risk": 5200.0}]
}
```

### `GET /forecast`
Query: `scenario` (`no_intervention` / `with_allocation`).
```json
{
  "scenario": "no_intervention",
  "points": [
    {"month": "2024-07-01", "actual": null, "forecast": 98500.0, "lower": 94500.0, "upper": 102500.0}
  ]
}
```

### `POST /allocate`
Request:
```json
{"budget": 20000, "strategy": "segment_aware"}
```
Response:
```json
{
  "budget": 20000,
  "spent": 19980.0,
  "expected_revenue_saved": 41200.0,
  "strategy": "segment_aware",
  "allocations": [
    {"customer_id": "C00001", "segment_id": 1, "value_tier": "high", "offer": "discount_10",
     "spend": 50.0, "expected_revenue_saved": 120.0, "reason": "..."}
  ]
}
```

### `GET /model/metrics`
```json
{
  "models": [
    {"name": "xgboost_calibrated", "pr_auc": 0.0, "brier": 0.0, "ece": 0.0}
  ],
  "calibration_curve": [{"bin_mean_pred": 0.1, "bin_frac_pos": 0.09}],
  "trained_at": "2024-06-30T00:00:00Z"
}
```
